registration.title: Create your profile
registration.intro: Your data stays on this phone. Nothing is sent anywhere.
registration.pinWarning: If you forget your PIN it cannot be recovered. The only way back in is to erase all the data on this phone.

unlock.wait: Too many attempts. Try again in {{seconds}} s.
unlock.eraseMessage: This deletes your profile, budgets and movements from this phone. It cannot be undone.
